definition: the conventional expression of acceptance (of a proposal or an offer): NORMATIVE-ENTRY COMMITMENT BOUND RESOLUTION OUTCOME-OF-A-RESOLUTION.ACCEPTANCE WHOLE-ENTRY ON-THE-MOVE
acts: acceptance (of a proposal or an offer)
pragmatic conditions: wherever the head it expands may be written
constructed history: Constructed history: the head NORMATIVE-ENTRY COMMITMENT BOUND RESOLUTION OUTCOME-OF-A-RESOLUTION.ACCEPTANCE WHOLE-ENTRY ON-THE-MOVE, frequent enough to be said as one word, shortened to the force word that now stands for it.
